metadata.title: AYURLEX / IP-SAKTI Sahayak — Complete Data Universe Inventory & Audit

US.corpus_origin: Harvard USPTO Dataset (HUPD) - Ayurvedic, botanical, herbal, and pharmaceutical patents
US.coverage_description: USPTO utility patents covering herbal extracts, synthetic derivatives, therapeutic methods, formulation processes, and medicinal plant applications.

JP.corpus_origin: LLM-jp Patent Corpus - JPO published patent applications (Kokai Tokkyo Koho) in herbal and botanical formulations
JP.coverage_description: JPO patent claims and descriptions in native Japanese for botanical compositions, herbal medicines (Kampo & Ayurvedic), extraction techniques, and health foods.

WO.corpus_origin: WIPO PATENTSCOPE PCT International Applications in A61K/A61P botanical, herbal, and natural product classes
WO.coverage_description: PCT International patent applications covering global cross-border filings, international search reports, and priority claims in natural medicinal products.

EP.corpus_origin: EPO European Patent Bulletin / Claims corpus covering EP applications in phytomedicines and pharmaceutical compositions
EP.coverage_description: EPO European patent applications and claims evaluated under EPC Article 54 (novelty), Article 56 (inventive step), and Article 54(5) second medical use.

IN.corpus_origin: Multi-source canonical Indian corpus: CGPDTM Patents, API Monographs, AFI Classical Formulations, Patents Act 1970 (Sec 3p/3e/10.4), TM Act 1999 (Sec 13), GI Act 1999, FSSAI Ayurveda Aahara 2022, D&C Rules 158B/Sched T, BDA 2002 (Sec 6), WHO Benchmarks, and Ayurvedic D2C commercialization standards
IN.coverage_description: Comprehensive Indian statutory, prior art, classical formulation, and regulatory database enabling multi-domain IP analysis and full cross-lingual retrieval.

raw_statutory_corpus.status: Fully Processed & Chunked into Production Vectors

docling_parsed_documents.status: Parsed Structural JSON and Cleaned Markdown

quarantined_records.description: Unverified or incomplete raw patent records (5 German DPMA patents, 10 Indian filings with missing claims, 2 malformed WIPO records) isolated to prevent hallucination
